#!/bin/bash

#FLUX --nodes=3
#FLUX --ntasks-per-node=1
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=2
#FLUX --mem-per-node=2gb

# set max execution time
#FLUX --time=0:02:00

# NOTE: The PBS directive 'place=pack:excl' has been translated to --exclusive.
# 'pack' is the default placement behavior and does not require a specific option.
#FLUX --exclusive

# imposta la coda di esecuzione
#FLUX --queue=short_cpuQ

module load mpich-3.2
module load valgrind-3.15.0 

# 'mpirun.actual' is replaced by Flux's native launcher, 'flux run'.
# The number of OpenMP threads is set via an environment variable.

# OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 flux run -n 3 valgrind --track-origins=yes --leak-check=full --verbose CLionProjects/HPC1/BFR/tests/test_BFR_parallel.o > HPC/BFR/output.txt 2>&1 # Full debug setup
# OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 flux run -n 3 valgrind CLionProjects/HPC1/BFR/tests/test_BFR_parallel.o > HPC/BFR/output.txt 2>&1 # Debug setup
OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 flux run -n 8 CLionProjects/HPC1/BFR/tests/test_BFR_parallel.o

# poi esegui "flux submit bfr_parallel_test.sh"
# non eseguire MAI manualmente!!

# mpicc tests/test_BFR_parallel.c lib/bfr_structures/bfr_structures.c lib/kmeans_wrapper/kmeans_wrapper.c lib/kmeans/kmeans.c src/BFR_parallel.c -o test/test_BFR_parallel.o -lm -fopenmp
